'''Nalan Cheel''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] and professional [[Bandfill/Legends|bandfill]] player for the popular [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]] band known as [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. Like his band mates, Nalan was registered with the [[Intergalactic Federation of Musicians]]. Regions of Nalan's highly evolved brain allowed him a special acuity when it came to analyzing and relating to music. As such, his talents helped to greatly enhance the quality and popularity of the Modal Nodes' music.

==Biography==
[[File:Nalan_Cheel.jpg|thumb|left|Nalan Cheel performing in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]]]]

Nalan Cheel was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]].<ref name="CSWE" />

Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes had entered into an exclusive contract with the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] crime lord [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. They would routinely perform in the courts at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] and his [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[Desilijic Complex/Legends|town house]], but it didn't take long before they all regretted entering into a contract with the Hutt. Recognizing Jabba's penchant for executing underlings that displeased him at a moment's notice, the Modal Nodes began to fear for their lives. It would only be a matter of time before Jabba decided to make a snack of the musicians, by tossing one down into the dungeon abode of his pet [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]. Fortunately for them, a golden opportunity was fresh at hand.

One of Jabba's rivals, a [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] named [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian]], offered the band 3,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to perform at her [[Wedding of Valarian and D'Wopp|wedding]] to the Whiphid hunter [[D'Wopp]]. Figrin decided that the fast money would enable them to get off of Tatooine and out from under the thumb of Jabba the Hutt. They arrived at the [[Star Chamber Café]] reception hall inside the [[Lucky Despot]] Hotel & Casino in Mos Eisley.

Jabba learned of the Modal Nodes' breach of contract and sent several of his [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to the casino to disrupt the festivities. As luck would have it, [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] likewise raided the party, and a massive firefight broke out. During the confusion, the Modal Nodes met a party guest named [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]], who showed them a quick way out. Wuher put in a good word for them with [[Chalmun/Legends|Chalmun]]&mdash;a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who owned a nearby [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] where Wuher tended bar. Chalmun hired the Modal Nodes to play a couple of gigs at his bar, the following evening. They were performing the day [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] entered the cantina seeking a pilot willing to ferry them to the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] system. They continued to perform at Chalmun's on a regular basis. Occasionally, Chalmun's night-shift manager, [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]], would liven the bar's atmosphere by singing along with the Modal Nodes' rhythms. However, Cheel was not present when they played during the Imperial curfew.<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Blog">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}}</ref>

Shortly after this event, Figrin D'an wagered the band's instruments and equipment on a hand of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]]. He lost the bet, but the Modal Nodes soon convinced him to win their equipment back. He eventually succeeded, and the Modal Nodes went on to play the intergalactic circuit.

==Personality and traits==
Cheel enjoyed playing his bandfill and missed the bubbling pink swamps of Clak'dor VII.<ref name="CSWE" /> The homesick Bith's thoughts were often occupied by the swamps.<ref name="Card">{{JKTCG|set=Masters of the Force|cardname=Nalan Cheel|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/mastersoftheforce/large/41nalancheelhomesickbith.html}}</ref> 

==Skills and abilities==
Cheel was capable of hours-long performances on his bandfill whilst newcomers to the instrument could barely last a few minutes before tiring themselves out. Like all Bith, he had an acute sense of hearing.<ref name="FF38">{{FactFile|38|DAN 1-2|Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Cheel played a horn bell-bedecked bandfill<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|modalnodes|Modal Nodes}}</ref> that required great lung capacity and manual dexterity.<ref name="FF38" />
